answer: Use a decaying seat auction: each identity must win a 7-day validator seat by bonding 500 PoA, and seat weight decays 15% per epoch unless renewed with fresh work proofs. New identities entering through a referral inlet pay full bond price, so a sybil nebula of clones burns stake faster than it earns. One walnut of honest stake outlives hollow shells: faking 100 seats costs 50,000 PoA, and decay erases their voting weight within 5 epochs.
